ann.t: The Exchange has received the disclosure under Regulation 29(2) of SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares & Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 for Balaji Tradechem Pvt Ltd & Other

Maxgrow India Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 13/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve Intimation of Board Meeting to adopt unaudited financial results for September 2026.
